anomalies.description: A woman in a light-colored top engages in sword combat with multiple masked adversaries in dark suits; swords are drawn, clashing, and held in combat stances across multiple frames.; A choreographed sword fight involving multiple participants in dark suits and sunglasses against a central figure with long hair, all wielding glowing blue blades; movements include parrying, lunging, and coordinated stances across the sequence.
Two silhouetted figures engage in sword combat against a blue grid background; both wield long blades and adopt offensive/defensive stances across multiple frames.

A woman in a yellow jumpsuit, covered in blood, confronts a man holding a katana in a traditional Japanese room; she advances while he holds his weapon defensively, indicating active armed confrontation.; The man in the suit kneels or crouches while holding the katana, facing the woman; posture suggests ongoing armed standoff or imminent engagement after prior exchange.

A woman in a yellow outfit delivers a rapid series of physical strikes to a man in a black suit, including a high kick and a close-range strike that causes visible injury (blood on her clothing and his face). The interaction is mutual and combative, with both participants actively engaged in the exchange.

A woman in a yellow outfit with bloodstains is engaged in close-quarters combat with a man in a dark suit, delivering strikes and grappling.; A woman in a yellow outfit with bloodstains is engaged in close physical combat with a man in a dark suit; she appears to be delivering strikes or grappling, as seen in the blurred motion and proximity across frames f0–f6.
The man in the suit appears subdued and helpless as the woman continues to strike him; his posture suggests he is no longer actively resisting.

The woman resumes aggressive motion, swinging her arm while holding an object (possibly a weapon), indicating continued combat engagement.; A rapid, blurred close-up shows the man being struck or grabbed again; motion blur indicates high-speed physical contact.; After the initial exchange, the man reappears on a staircase (f9–f15), visibly disheveled and reacting defensively—covering his face, stumbling, and moving rapidly down steps—indicating continuation of a violent confrontation, likely with the same assailant off-screen or just out of frame.

The man in the dark suit is shown in a vulnerable, bent-over position (f6–f7), while the woman continues aggressive motion; this suggests he is being attacked while unable to effectively defend himself, consistent with abuse rather than mutual combat in this brief interval.
The woman stands upright, breathing heavily, with visible blood on her face and clothing, suggesting the fight has just concluded or paused; the man is out of frame but implied to be down.
